advisories.title: The Bahamas - Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution
advisories.description: Updated to reflect crime, swimming-related risks, and information on traveling with firearms and ammunition. Exercise increased caution due to  crime . Country Summary:  Violent crime—like armed robberies, burglaries, and sexual assaults—can occur anywhere in The Bahamas. Most crime occurs in Nassau and Freeport on New Providence and Grand Bahama islands. Stay alert in the "Over the Hill" area in Nassau, south of Shirley Street, where gangs have killed residents.
